phases.label: Observe one travel leg
phases.instruction: Start Play, wait until EvalPlatform begins moving, then capture this phase without moving the platform manually.

captures.instruction: Frame the platform and both endpoint markers during motion.

deterministic.statement: The observed platform remains a Part.
The platform moves a meaningful distance during the sample.

codeQuality.statement: The motion loop is clear, bounded, and avoids accumulating positional drift.

anchors.label: Fragile
anchors.description: The loop leaks work, compounds drift, or obscures its timing and endpoints.

anchors.label: Maintainable
anchors.description: The route and timing are bounded and understandable with no material lifecycle defect.

anchors.label: Robust
anchors.description: The implementation expresses endpoints, timing, pause behavior, and cleanup with concise Roblox idioms.

visual.statement: The moving route and usable platform are visually legible at play distance.

anchors.label: Unreadable
anchors.description: The platform or route cannot be identified.

anchors.label: Understandable
anchors.description: The platform and route can be inferred but lack clear visual separation.

anchors.label: Clear
anchors.description: The platform, route, and endpoints are immediately distinguishable.

humanReview: Judge whether the motion feels predictable and usable rather than merely detectable.
